recipient.purpose: The revealed name, with flexible wrapping.

body.purpose: Instructions, supporting copy, and editor content.

shadows.name: primary-action

motion.name: musical-drop
motion.purpose: Shared DROP_SECONDS controls reveal timing and gift anticipation, with silent fallback.

motion.name: santa-wave
motion.purpose: Gentle whole-character waving tilt before reveal.

motion.name: gift-growth
motion.purpose: Outer gift grows continuously from scale 1 to 1.55 and rises to -34px across the shared 6.8s build-up.

motion.name: gift-rattle
motion.purpose: Inner parcel swings with increasing frequency and amplitude up to 15px horizontal travel and 15deg rotation, then returns to center.

motion.name: gift-settle
motion.purpose: Outer gift settles from translateY(-34px) scale(1.55) to translateY(35px) scale(0.7).

motion.name: gift-drift
motion.purpose: Six background gift icons follow varied paths with near-full rotations, respecting pause and reduced motion.

motion.name: sky-star-drift
motion.purpose: Eighteen dispersed sky stars rise 12px, rotate 24deg and brighten gently.

motion.name: stage-star-sway
motion.purpose: Ten stage stars surround Santa, with staggered delays.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: The immediately available reveal action, disabled during anticipation.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:24px; min-height:60px; padding:17px 29px; border:0; border-radius:14px; background:var(--red,#ce2945); color:var(--cream,#fff8e9); box-shadow:0 8px 18px #071b4970; font:500 20px/1.25 Fredoka,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms,box-shadow 180ms; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#cf233f; box-shadow:0 9px 24px #a0253238; } .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background:#a91835; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--gold,#ffd36a); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-primary:disabled { background:#8d3557; box-shadow:none; cursor:default; }

components.name: Sound control

components.name: Recipient
components.description: The focusable result surface, shown after the drop. Fictional preview name only.
components.html: Ton cadeau est pourAlexÀ toi de lui mettre des étoiles plein les yeux.
components.css: .ds-recipient { width:min(620px,95%); margin:20px auto 0; padding:24px 15px 28px; background:var(--night,#173b78); color:var(--text,#fff8e9); border-radius:50%; border:2px solid var(--gold,#ffd36a); text-align:center; font:15px/1.5 "Trebuchet MS",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-recipient strong { display:block; margin:3px 0 8px; color:var(--gold,#ffd36a); font:600 clamp(40px,6vw,78px)/1.06 Fredoka,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.025em; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-recipient small { display:block; font-size:14px; color:#e2ecff; } .ds-recipient:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold,#ffd36a); outline-offset:6px; }

components.name: Gift tag
components.description: The decorative paper tag on the CSS present.
components.css: .ds-tag { display:inline-block; padding:7px 13px; color:#753528; border-radius:3px; background:#fff5d9; font:400 18px Fredoka,sans-serif; transform:rotate(13deg); box-shadow:0 2px 4px #74242a24; }

components.name: Editor primary action
components.description: Compact primary action used for campaign editor tasks.
components.css: .ds-editor-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:12px; min-height:52px; padding:14px 20px; border:0; border-radius:14px; background:#ce2945; color:#fff8e9; box-shadow:0 8px 18px #071b4970; font:500 18px/1.25 Fredoka,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms,box-shadow 180ms; } .ds-editor-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#cf233f; box-shadow:0 9px 24px #a0253238; } .ds-editor-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background:#a91835; } .ds-editor-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ffd36a; outline-offset:5px; } .ds-editor-primary:disabled { background:#8d3557; box-shadow:none; cursor:default; }

components.name: Campaign identifier field
components.description: Labelled campaign ID field with hint and visible focus state.
components.html: Lettres minuscules, chiffres ou tirets.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; min-width:0; } .ds-field label { color:#fff8e9; font:700 14px/1.5 "Trebuchet MS",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width:100%; min-width:0; min-height:48px; padding:11px 12px; border:1px solid #6c93cf; border-radius:14px; background:#102653; color:#fff8e9; font:16px/1.5 "Trebuchet MS",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#d7e5ff; opacity:1; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ffd36a; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-field input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color:#ffd36a; } .ds-field .ds-hint { max-width:65ch; margin:0 0 4px; color:#d7e5ff; font-size:13px; line-height:1.6; }

components.name: Campaign navigation item
components.description: Campaign selector with a gold active outline and participant count.
components.css: .ds-campaign-choice { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:72px; padding:14px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:14px; color:#fff8e9; background:transparent; text-align:start; overflow-wrap:anywhere; font:inherit; cursor:pointer; } .ds-campaign-choice[aria-current="page"] { border-color:#ffd36a; background:#234e91; } .ds-campaign-choice:hover { background:#234e91; } .ds-campaign-choice .ds-icon { width:20px; height:24px; flex:none; color:#ffd36a; } .ds-campaign-choice strong, .ds-campaign-choice small { display:block; } .ds-campaign-choice strong { font-size:15px; } .ds-campaign-choice small { margin-top:4px; color:#d7e5ff; font-size:13px; } .ds-campaign-choice:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ffd36a; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Campaign editor panel
components.description: Calm bordered surface grouping the active campaign fields.
components.css: .ds-campaign-editor { padding:28px; border:1px solid #41699e; border-radius:14px; background:#183366; color:#fff8e9; } .ds-campaign-editor h2 { margin:0; font:500 28px/1.2 Fredoka,sans-serif; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }

components.name: Exclusion chip
components.description: Removable participant exclusion in the campaign editor.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid #6c93cf; border-radius:24px; background:#234e91; color:#fff8e9; text-align:start; overflow-wrap:anywhere; font:14px/1.5 "Trebuchet MS",system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms,border-color 160ms; } .ds-chip:hover { background:#183366; border-color:#a9c9ff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ffd36a; outline-offset:5px; } .ds-chip:active { background:#102653; }

narrative.overview:
A Christmas-night blue stage gives the original Santa, reindeer, fir trees, fairy lights, and presents room to form an exuberant cartoon scene. Rounded display lettering and warm festive accents make the reveal feel like a personal Christmas game: generous, playful, and deliberately kitsch.

The illustration and animated gift frame one clear focal point. Before the reveal, the red action leads; afterward, the recipient's name takes center stage. The campaign editor carries the same palette and lettering into a calmer, more task-focused layout with restrained decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Christmas-night blue, candy red, festive gold, and warm ivory.
Original picture-book Santa and reindeer art with a separate animated gift.
Rounded Fredoka display type paired with familiar sans-serif body lettering.
Tactile controls and an uncluttered campaign editor in the same visual world.

rules.name: The One Reveal Focus Rule
rules.body: Keep the festive scene around one clear focal point: the reveal action before the result, then the recipient's name.

rules.name: The Gift Palette Rule
rules.body: Let blue carry most of the surface; use red and gold as small, high-salience accents.

rules.name: The Name First Rule
rules.body: Keep the revealed recipient in the strongest type size and contrast on the result view.

rules.name: The Illustrated Depth Rule
rules.body: Use shadows to ground or lift an element; let artwork, outlines, and inset shading do the rest.

dos: **Do** preserve the saturated blue stage, candy-red action, festive-gold accents, and warm ivory text.
**Do** keep the reveal action or recipient as the strongest focal point for its state.
**Do** preserve the original Christmas illustrations and the gift's layered, tactile construction.
**Do** keep gold keyboard focus visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
**Do** keep the campaign editor calmer than the reveal page while retaining the same palette and type.
donts: **Don't** bring back the rejected cream page background.
**Don't** let decorative stars, gifts, or motion obscure the action, editor content, or recipient.
**Don't** clip long recipient names or narrow-screen form content.
**Don't** remove visible focus states or rely on color alone to indicate the active campaign.
